acceptance_criteria: A test with a packaged Apache fixture (ubuntu-apache) whose module deletion state is null shows that worker assessed, not omitted, among identical children.
A test with inventory facts that, with the bundled catalog, exceed 1024 gets a RuntimeException whose message names the inventory and catalog fact counts and the limit; same for sources.
goal: PR #46 CodeRabbit minors on 81bded7: (1) Apache targets keep a null apache_php_module_deleted state as deleted=null instead of false, so a packaged Apache worker whose deletion state is unknown never shares an identity (rank 0 kept); null stays falsy for patch-status logic. (2) When inventory plus catalog-level facts or sources alone exceed the 1024-fact or 256-source limit, the report is rejected with a clear error naming the inventory and catalog-level counts and the limit, instead of the generic schema-collection message; the documented behavior (report fails in that case) is unchanged.
non_goals: No change to admission, catalog caps, verdicts or collector bounds.
